input.summary: Limit Vendor audits to once per 12 months on 30 days' written notice, in business hours, off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, and delete remote system access.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept unlimited, unannounced audits with remote access to our systems, so we have limited audits to once in any 12-month period on 30 days' written notice, in business hours, off-site where possible and through an independent auditor bound by confidentiality. Section 22.2 already keeps audit costs with Vendor unless underpayment exceeds five percent and bars direct access to our systems.

ops.oldText: Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
ops.newText: Vendor may audit Customer no more than once in any 12-month period, on 30 days' written notice, during business hours, off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
